teamInvitation.subject: You've been invited to join a salon team on GuGu Studio
teamInvitation.preheader: The invitation is valid for 72 hours.
teamInvitation.heading: Join {{salonName}}
teamInvitation.body: You've been invited to join {{salonName}} on GuGu Studio to see your working hours and appointments. Tap the button below and sign in with this email. The invitation is valid for 72 hours and can be used once.
teamInvitation.ignore: If you don't know this salon, you can ignore this email.
